changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE clinlims.system_user ADD CONSTRAINT cleanup_user_person_fk FOREIGN KEY (linked_provider_person_id) REFERENCES clinlims.person(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
ALTER TABLE clinlims.sample_environmental ADD CONSTRAINT cleanup_env_sample_fk FOREIGN KEY (samp_id) REFERENCES clinlims.sample(id)
ALTER TABLE clinlims.cleanup_test_hold ADD CONSTRAINT cleanup_hold_person_fk FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES clinlims.person(id)
CREATE TRIGGER audit_event_no_change BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON clinlims.audit_event FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION clinlims.cleanup_test_protect_audit()
CREATE TRIGGER audit_event_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON clinlims.audit_event FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION clinlims.cleanup_test_protect_audit()
